name: labs/fretchen__synqs_devices
title: Andor Solis camera (synqs_devices)
intro: Andor Solis camera (synqs_devices), adapted from fretchen/synqs_devices. It reads `frame_width`, `frame_height`, `x_binning`, `y_binning` and 2 more; sets `exposure_time`, `acquisition_mode`, `trigger_mode`, `trigger_edge` and 2 more; runs `snap`. `snap`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
